A_basis: production settings reconstructed from CSV; BBS/live research unavailable

config.historical_split_reason: Chosen on odds coverage only before calculating scores: Pinnacle columns stop in January 2026, so a February boundary would leave no market-informed audit cohort. Both periods remain retrospective and already inspected.

model_upgrade_comparison.note: Production v1 replays the per-run half-life tuning at every fold origin on the fold's training rows. Pinnacle nominal-opening O/U 2.5 stands in for the fresh live quote; missing quotes leave totals unanchored. Shot features run their own per-fold chronological gate.

config.promotion_policy: No automatic promotion. Historical periods have already been inspected and are retrospective diagnostics. Select candidates using development only; audit scores cannot select. A candidate needs later, genuinely untouched pre-kickoff forecasts, adequate paired coverage, calibration checks and manual approval before production changes. Historical closing inputs are oracle diagnostics and never promotion-eligible. No ROI, CLV or live bet recommendation can be inferred from these untimestamped CSV odds.

interval_warning: Descriptive intervals are not adjusted for repeated candidate/market testing and cannot authorize promotion.
reliability_warning: Offer-weighted descriptive bins may contain correlated offers and different candidate coverage. They are not paired promotion evidence.
roi_reason: Probability diagnostics only; existing forward tracking grades the actual shortlist. No historical tradability claim.
timing: nominal opening odds lack observation timestamps; retrospective diagnostics only
